open_decisions.question: UTLMON00 is a confirmed utility (system monitor: writes an alert when THRESHOLD-MET, BR-129; repeats monitoring cycles 'UNTIL WS-HOUR = 23', BR-130). Is UTLMON00 modernised, retired, replaced by platform monitoring/observability services, or kept as operational tooling?

UTLMON00 is classified utility (confirmed): classified as utility (confirmed); a human must decide whether it is in modernisation scope. Keep it in the modernisation scope (resolved_no_change) or exclude it (excluded_from_scope)?
COPY DB2STAT in UTLMON00 (line 43) names the program DB2STAT, not a copybook, and SELECT DB2-STATS (INDEXED, RECORD KEY STAT-KEY) has no FD. What is the record layout of DB2-STATS?

WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is referenced but declared nowhere in TSTGEN00, TSTVAL00, UTLMNT00, UTLMON00 and UTLVAL00 (it may have been expected from ERRHAND or RTNCODE). What is its intended layout and owning copybook?

Which character encoding (code page) do the files and areas described by these copybooks use for DISPLAY data on the legacy platform (EBCDIC 037, 1140, another EBCDIC variant, or ASCII)? The zoned-decimal test vectors and String codecs depend on it.

If UTLMON00 is kept: GAP-006 (critical) - COPY DB2STAT (line 43) names a program, not a copybook, so the DB2-STATS record has no layout; GAP-008 - static CALL to the runtime routine ILBOABN0 (line 186) cannot be traced (does control return?); GAP-020 - 13 configuration, metric, threshold, logging and alert paragraphs are not in the source; GAP-041 - WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is declared nowhere; GAP-080 - the loop condition WS-HOUR = 23 may never be met because ACCEPT FROM TIME writes into a group starting with WS-DATE. Can the full source and DB2STAT layout be located, and what is the intended effect of ILBOABN0?

GAP-092 (medium, DIAGRAM_RENDER_UNVERIFIED) is not addressed by any decision or requirement: Visual rendering of the 65 Mermaid diagrams is unverified. Acknowledge it as a known limitation (resolved_no_change) or exclude the affected units?

GAP-104 (low, DIAGRAM_INCOMPLETE) is not addressed by any decision or requirement: COMP-UNRESOLVED: all seven edges are unsupported. Acknowledge it as a known limitation (resolved_no_change) or exclude the affected units?
